purpose: Descriptive paired comparison of rms_fixed against identity on the completed controls360 ledger; no model selection, candidate update, GPU, API, SSH, or rerun.

population_and_pairing.pairing_rule: Require exactly one identity and one rms_fixed row per paired_identity_fields tuple; retain every complete pair.

primary_support.rule: Use the exact full-support scores already emitted by the frozen scorer. Do not recompute scores and do not use guard20 metrics in the primary estimand.

estimands.contrast: rms_fixed minus identity within exact paired identity; average pair differences within speaker and model; average ten speaker means for each model.
estimands.equal_model_target: Arithmetic mean of the three model-specific estimates; in every bootstrap draw, compute each model's speaker-clustered estimate, then average the three model estimates.

metric_family.name: Cbest
metric_family.definition: Median over the 31-lag mean-distance curve minus its minimum.

metric_family.name: D0
metric_family.definition: Distance at column 15, the scorer's declared zero-lag column.

metric_family.name: Canchor
metric_family.definition: Median over the 31-lag mean-distance curve minus distance at the fixed anchor column; validate anchor_column equals zero_lag_column for every row.

metric_family.name: best_lag_frames
metric_family.definition: Signed lag-frame location of the minimum of the 31-lag mean-distance curve; also report a derived absolute-distance estimand.

metric_family.name: abs_best_lag_frames
metric_family.definition: Absolute signed best_lag_frames; paired contrast is abs(rms_fixed best lag) minus abs(identity best lag), so a negative contrast is closer to zero/fixed clock.

uncertainty.method: Speaker-cluster bootstrap with replacement, preserving all paired rows within each resampled speaker.
uncertainty.rng: Python random.Random (MT19937), randrange(10) repeated 10 times per bootstrap replicate.
uncertainty.studentization: For each of 28 family estimates, divide centered bootstrap deviations (bootstrap estimate minus observed estimate) by the bootstrap sample standard deviation; use the 0.99 nearest-rank quantile of the replicate-wise maximum absolute studentized deviation.
uncertainty.interval: Observed estimate plus/minus the simultaneous max-t critical value times that estimate's bootstrap standard deviation; no clipping.
uncertainty.scope_note: Approximate cluster-bootstrap intervals over the ten frozen speakers; they do not change the terminal result or qualify a candidate.

support_coverage_reporting.guard20: Report actual score.support_by_support.guard20 eligible and query_count for every unique paired clip/model identity; do not infer eligibility from the support name or substitute it for full support.
support_coverage_reporting.frame_counts: Report emitted render.frame_count and official_evaluator.receipt.video_frame_count for each unique paired clip/model identity as separate counts, not as guard query counts.
support_coverage_reporting.pair_consistency: Require both method rows in each pair to have identical full and guard20 support records and equal render/evaluator frame counts.
